div.span: Cybersecurity & AI Student @ UMA | NVIDIA DLI Certified | Co-Founder @ COMPUteens

div.div:
Last week I presented at the Technology Intern Showcase event at Dow Jones, and it honestly felt like the perfect way to wrap up these past months.
It was such a great opportunity to share my contribution during this internship with people from different teams, and to strengthen my public speaking skills along the way. A huge congrats to my fellow interns too, everyone presented and it was inspiring to see the variety of projects and the effort behind each one :)
I worked on two main projects during my time here, and I learnt so much from both of them, not just technically, but in how to approach problems. It was challenging at times, and I had to push through moments where things didn't work the way I expected, but I was lucky to have people in my team who were always willing to help and answer my questions.
Tomorrow is officially my last day, which still feels a bit surreal… I can't believe how fast these months have gone by.
#DJIntern26 #workingatDJ :))
